# HisabIQ Monthly/Yearly Business Review — implementation specification
Date: 2026-10-27 · Status: user requested build · Parent: attached Reports UI/UX blueprint §11.
## Selected direction
Use one **Reports → Business Review** workspace, not new sidebar sections or a 12th Magic Patterns tab. Monthly, yearly, custom and last 24 completed months share one calculation engine. Label user-facing output **Business Review / Internal Audit Sheet**; never pretend it is a statutory audit, certified P&L, balance sheet or bank-approved document. Keep original eleven Reports destinations and existing 34 source reports.
## Sources and accounting rules
Consume `useReportData` / `buildReportData` as the sole operational preview source. Every visible figure links to existing `ReportDetails` evidence. Cash receipts/payment allocations are not sales or accounting profit. Recorded purchases are not cost of goods sold. Returns have no complete historical cost reversal; profit must remain unavailable where affected. Missing costs and unverified periods produce null/unavailable, never zero or today's replacement purchase price. Report past stock, receivables and payables as unavailable unless as-of reconstruction is proven; period-end snapshots cannot be summed. Keep signed transfer movement out of trading performance. No mutations, postings, account approvals or external transmissions.
## Owner journey
Reports header → Business Review → select monthly/yearly/custom/last 24 completed months → inspect concise Summary (sales/returns, expenses, purchases, receipt/payments, current stock/due, top 3 priorities) → Monthly figures (each row's source, missing-data status) → Documents (print short explicitly incomplete draft and CSV of observed monthly figures) → Review history (session-only drafts; don't advertise immutable external storage). Export explicitly states preview assumptions and reporting date.
## UI and QA
Use HisabIQ shared Button/Input/AppSelect/AppDateRangePicker/Table/StatusBadge, Geist/Hind Siliguri, 36px controls, compact 13/12/11 table roles, proportional digits, Party Ledger-style underline tabs. Bilingual labels and Bangla helper. Test desktop 1440, tablet 1024/768, phone 390/360, keyboard, dark/light, no global overflow. No new React Router route; `?workspace=business-review` persists URL state. Do not remove Magic Patterns visual authority or original report library filters and drill-downs.
## Deferred, not silently implemented
Historical balanced finance accounts, immutable issued audit archives, approved/reviewed signatures and RBAC, Premium entitlement checks, bank-specific pack composition and actual PDF/XLSX generators depend on complete source/settings/backend contracts (see attached blueprint R4–R7). Do not show controls for services that don't exist.


## Approved correction — A4 five-page owner audit pack (27 October 2026)
The primary **Print owner summary** is no longer a one-page table: it is a **five-page A4 portrait illustrated management pack**. The interactive Reports Summary and Monthly figures remain; the print contract is separate from the existing generic A4-landscape source table renderer. Use actual recorded sources and SVG vector charts in the print document; no visual screenshot rasterizations, empty decorative pie charts, or browser-dependent Recharts canvas captures.

Fixed page composition (same in monthly, yearly, custom and 24-month modes; monthly figures CSV/landscape print remain separate supporting schedule):
1. **Overview:** period sales/returns, purchases, expenses, recorded cash in/out; trend chart, readiness indicators and operating context.
2. **Sales & customers:** top five selling products by recorded sales amount, top five buying customers by sales invoice value, top five products by known sale-time gross contribution; at least one bar and one pie chart with explicit known-cost coverage.
3. **Purchasing & stock:** top five suppliers by recorded purchase value, top ordered products by recorded purchase-line value/known quantities, stock/low-stock snapshot labelled with the actual as-of or unavailable; supplier pie and purchase bars.
4. **Dues & expenses:** outstanding invoice and supplier bill lists only for the **current** as-of snapshot; for historical dates show unavailable, not present balances. Expense rows/category chart and customer-versus-supplier due bars (when supported). Invoice age is not overdue without due-date evidence.
5. **Finance & priorities:** finance transaction list with transfer classification, recorded inflow/outflow chart, and up to three existing source-evidence-based Advisor recommendations; record reference and explicit limitations.

Formatting: distinct A4 portrait pages with deterministic page breaks and 1/5–5/5 running page labels; HisabIQ ink/teal/mint typography, Geist/Hind Siliguri, restrained chart colors, legends and units, sharp vector SVG/print-safe tables. Limit each top list to five ranked rows, add clearly labelled "No recorded data" when empty. Money is BDT, show date boundaries and data-cutoff. Charts are truthful visualizations of the same records used in the adjacent tables. All user names/record references are HTML/XML escaped. Supporting source references are printed; drill-down remains in the on-screen workspace.
The product-performance list must not invent margins from present-day cost; where historical cost or return allocation is incomplete show only known-line contribution with an explicit partial label, not net profit. Sales amounts minus purchase payments are never profits. Current stock/receivables/payables never masquerade as historical closing balances.
